brief:
The Israeli army will end its military operation in Hebron in the occupied West Bank "within days," the Israeli Broadcasting Corporation reported. The timeline suggests an imminent conclusion to the operation, though no specific end date was disclosed.

The operation in Hebron, a major Palestinian city in the southern West Bank, has been ongoing as part of Israeli military activities in the territory. Details about the scope of the operation or reasons for its planned withdrawal were not provided.
dek: Israeli military to end Hebron operation ‘within days’, Israeli media reports The Israeli army will end its military operation in Hebron in the occupied West Bank “within days”, the Israeli Broadcasting Corporation said.
title: Israeli military to wrap up Hebron operation within days
